| System | Native structure | Principal contribution to SOL |

| Arabic | Expanded Semitic consonantal inventory | Root-pattern morphology and sound distinctions |
| Egyptian hieroglyphs | Mixed phonetic/logographic system | Signs, phonetics, and semantic classifiers |
| **Babylonian cuneiform** | Logosyllabic, polyvalent signs | Multiple readings and grammatical context |
| **Rosetta Stone** | Parallel Egyptian/Greek texts in three scripts | Independently anchored translation |
| Enochian | 21-letter constructed alphabet | Separate structural comparison |
